answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the copper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A prism of per-task receipts records who did what, and the thread of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
